hypothesis: A small CNN that maps the current two-layer state (layer thickness plus centred zonal and meridional velocities for both layers) and the surface wind stress to the next state establishes a first reference score for fully autoregressive rollouts on the two-layer double-gyre shifting-wind dataset.
